Place Name Generator

Name towns, kingdoms, and taverns — three place modes with original syllable banks for fantasy maps and stories.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick town, kingdom, or tavern mode.
  2. Choose how many names to generate.
  3. Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do the three modes differ?

Towns use English-style roots (Oakford, Thornbury), kingdoms use majestic endings (Aldoria), taverns use “The” + adjective + noun.

Are these copied from fantasy books?

All names are original syllable combinations — original place names for your maps, games, and stories.

How do I copy a name?

Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
